report:
Pleural fluid, right

Received is 50 ml of blood-stained fluid, processed as cytospin (2 slides) and cell block (1 block).

The cytospin (2 slides) and cell block (1 slide) are adequate for evaluation and show reactive mesothelial cells, a second, foreign cell population, three-dimensional clusters and atypical cells with vacuolated cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli. Immunostaining on the cell block shows the malignant cells to be positive for TTF-1, napsin A and BerEP4 and negative for calretinin and WT1, while the mesothelial cells show the converse pattern. Features are those of metastatic adenocarcinoma, consistent with lung primary.

PLEURAL FLUID, right - METASTATIC ADENOCARCINOMA, CONSISTENT WITH LUNG PRIMARY (TIS: Malignant)
